desc: Simple and easy to use, the ThOR LT is a powerful thermal scope at an affordable price. Without the advanced features of our flagship line, ThOR LT is another great addition to the proven lineup of thermal imaging scopes from ATN. The affordable infrared hunting scope is lightweight, has up to 10 hours of battery life, and features one-shot zeroing. ThOR LT is the perfect compact and powerful thermal rifle scope for the average hunter looking for excellent performance. This thermal hunting scope is available in several configurations and mounts to most standard rails.
